title: Record the gap in the simultaneous production bounds
body:
## Summary
- No integer precision from 101 through 4463 admits a scale `u >= ceil(log2(8p))` and a positive integer spacing `d` with `u*d <= p` and `d-2 > 4w`, where `w = ceil(sqrt(16p/u))+2`.
- At precision 101 the least such product is 630.
- Precision 4464 is the first that works, at `u = 16`, `d = 279` and `w = 69`. The selected κ is unchanged.
